description: This source file defines a function to retrieve the current used CPU memory of the process on Linux systems by parsing /proc/self/status for VmRSS and VmSwap entries.

methods.name: SearchForMemoryValue
methods.description: Searches for a specific memory value in the buffer by looking for a key, then parses and returns the value in bytes.

methods.name: SbSystemGetUsedCPUMemory
methods.description: Reads /proc/self/status, extracts VmRSS and VmSwap values, and returns their sum in bytes.
